mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and HOUST increases by > 5% MoM, it signals supply chain resilience and housing market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5% and HOUST MoM growth > 5%
failure_condition: This mechanism's walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery regimes, a > 2% MoM increase in RSAFS signals rebounding consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of post-shock recovery instances with RSAFS MoM growth above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL inflation rate (> 1%) indicates real interest rates, influencing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: This mechanism's walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a > 0.5% increase in PAYEMS signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with PAYEMS increase above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit > 2% growth rates (YoY and MoM, respectively), it indicates robust supply chain and housing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 2% and HOUST MoM growth > 2%
failure_condition: This mechanism's walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
